ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast; dominated by low-intensity dark-gray to black pixels (approximately 90%) with isolated high-intensity white and tan pixel clusters (approximately 10%) concentrated at tips and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous dark pigmentation block. Distinct high-contrast tan/brown geometric textured masses are located at the left and right distal tips. Isolated circular white pixel clusters (scars) are distributed non-uniformly across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression; inner lobe boundaries converge at an approximate 45-degree angle with a rounded base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5 to 20 pixels relative to the local mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward curvature of the leading edges towards the distal tips; lobes exhibit an asymmetrical upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, circular white/light-gray pixel clusters of varying diameters (5-15 pixels) scattered across both ventral surfaces, particularly visible on the lower-left and mid-right lobe sections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-relief clusters of living barnacles (Coronula diadema) at both distal fluke tips; multiple circular depigmented attachment scars across the ventral surface.
